# Calculator Hub

> Free, privacy-first online calculators. All arithmetic and date math runs in the browser — no accounts, no stored inputs.

Calculator Hub (AllCalcs) provides accurate utility calculators for dates, education, and everyday planning. Formulas stay transparent; coming-soon tools are listed on the homepage but are not available yet.

## Live pages

- [Home](/): Catalog of live and planned calculators, search, FAQ, and methodology.
- [Date & Time Calculators](/date-time): Hub for calendar and working-day tools.
- [Days Between Two Dates](/date-time/days-between-dates): Exact days, weeks, months, and optional business-day counts between two dates.
- [Age Calculator](/date-time/age-calculator): Exact age in years, months, and days from a date of birth.
- [Business Days Calculator](/date-time/business-days-calculator): Working days between two dates (weekends excluded).
- [Add or Subtract Days](/date-time/add-subtract-days): Add or subtract days, weeks, months, or years from a date.
- [Math & Education Calculators](/math): Hub for percentage and GPA tools.
- [Percentage Calculator](/math/percentage-calculator): Percent of a number, percent change, and related modes.
- [GPA & CGPA Calculator](/math/gpa-calculator): SGPA, CGPA, weighted GPA, and common grading scales.

## Site pages

- [About](/about): What Calculator Hub is and how tools stay private.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy for calculator inputs and analytics.
- [Contact](/contact): Request a new calculator or ask a question.

## Planned (not live)

Finance (loan payment, compound interest, savings goal) and Health (BMI, calorie needs, pregnancy due date) calculators are listed as coming soon and do not have public routes yet.

## Contact

Use the on-site request form (/contact or /#request-tool) to suggest a new calculator.
